BiblicalUsage: Folly is the word, and the prophets are its example. Jeremiah says he has seen folly in the prophets of Samaria, who prophesied in Baal and caused Israel to err, while Job, in all his suffering, sinned not and did not charge God foolishly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the contrast is the lesson: folly is not only a fool's mistake, it is a prophet speaking for a god who is not God, and Job's refusal to do the same is the wiser way.
